subject: general
question:
Consider the given statement and decide which of the given assumption(s) is/are implicit in the statement.

**Statement:** Sally wanted to invite Harry over for a good dinner, so she made broccoli soup and apple pie for him.

**Assumptions:**

I. Harry will accept the dinner invitation.

II. Harry likes broccoli soup and apple pie.

III. Harry doesn’t like apple pie too much.

options.text: Only assumptions I and II are implicit.
Only assumptions II and III are implicit.
